title: Replace JSON Windows With RJV In Algorithms
description: Replace all JSON-rendering windows in semio/algorithms (Kit/Store story and any other) with @microlink/react-json-view. Install the package: npm i @microlink/react-json-view. Swap plain <pre>+JSON.stringify displays in the algorithm story windows (DiffViewer, SnapshotViewer, EventsFeed) with react-json-view for collapsible, readable, theme-aware JSON rendering.
